rationale: R01-024 'disappointed by the card policy' is treated as a card restriction (cash_only -> dish-pay, 1 review, medium); the policy is not stated explicitly, so dish-pay is acceptable rather than required. Queues (R01-012, R01-020, R01-023) are walk-in queues for a table -> other_unmapped.
Only walk-in queues (R02-018, R02-021, R02-027) and generic slow service (R02-023) -> other_unmapped. Risk: queues misread as counter_checkout_queue.
R03-001 'Reserved online. No table.' -> reservation_management_failure (1 review, medium). R03-011 half-hour wait is unclear (table or food) -> other_unmapped.

R04-007 'difficult to reach by phone' -> unanswered_phone_calls -> dish-ai-phone-assistant + prerequisite dish-professional-reservation. R04-013 missing takeaway item (compensated) -> order_error -> dish-pos; weak, so acceptable only. Both medium with support 1; tie-break puts dish-ai-phone-assistant first.
R05-007 missing sides and wrong serving order -> order_error / kitchen_delay -> dish-pos (1 review, medium). R05-013 'service nearly absent' -> other_unmapped.
Complaints are prices, tight seating, generic understaffed or neglectful service (R06-006, R06-010), fixed seating slots and language issues -> all other_unmapped.

R07-003 'The pho was good, but by no means worth the wait.' is treated as a wait for food -> kitchen_delay -> dish-pos (1 review, medium); the wait is not stated explicitly, so dish-pos is acceptable rather than required. Prices, food and generic slow service (R07-020) -> other_unmapped. R07-019 missing listed soy mince is a dish-content issue, not an order error.
Almost entirely positive; R08-001 and R08-007 are food-quality remarks -> other_unmapped. Booking recommendations are not pain points.
R09-001 'We waited two hours for our food.' -> kitchen_delay -> dish-pos (1 review, medium). R09-003 'Terrible experience.' has no stated cause.
R12-001 only accepts cash payments -> cash_only -> dish-pay (1 review, medium). Only one review in the dataset.

R13-001, R13-002 card payment not accepted -> cash_only -> dish-pay (high, support 2). R13-003, R13-006 website prices differ from in-store prices -> outdated_online_information -> dish-starter (high, support 2). Tie broken by product_id: dish-pay first.

R15-001, R15-004, R15-005 no card payment -> cash_only / card_payment_failure -> dish-pay (high, support 3). R15-002 extra eight euros on the bill -> billing_error -> dish-pos (medium); single disputed incident, so acceptable only. R15-006 missing receipt after cash payment -> other_unmapped.
R16-001, R16-002 only cash payment -> cash_only -> dish-pay (high, support 2). R16-004 10-15 minute wait for a table -> other_unmapped.
